## Checklist

- [ ] Builds with no warnings (`make`)
- [ ] No new vendor-channel command, or it follows the rules in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Every exit path still restores normal mode
- [ ] No keystrokes or clipboard contents in logs
- [ ] New files have SPDX headers
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
